rules.description: [hanyeong] 한/영(F18) → 누르는 순간 입력 소스 직접 전환 (macOS 단축키는 뗄 때 전환돼서 빠르게 치면 첫 글자가 이전 언어로 들어감)
[winkeys] Ctrl+Arrow = word move (Opt+Arrow), terminals excluded; Ctrl+Shift+Arrow passed raw to HWP [word-move]
[winkeys] Home/End = line start/end, Ctrl+Home/End = doc start/end (Win style), terminals excluded [home-end]
[winkeys] Ctrl+K / Ctrl+L = focus Chrome address bar (Cmd+L), Chrome only [Chrome address]
